task.title: Configure Wi-Fi Settings
task.shortdesc: Configure the Wi-Fi network name, security mode, and password on the .

prereq.p: Before you configure the Wi-Fi settings, make sure that:

ul.li: The is connected to the or Optical Network Terminal (ONT).
A computer or mobile device is connected to the .
You have the credentials for the .

context.p: Use the to configure the wireless network. The Wi-Fi network name identifies the network to wireless devices. The security mode and Wi-Fi password protect the network from unauthorized access.
context.note: Record the new Wi-Fi network name and password before you apply the settings. Wireless devices must use the new settings to reconnect.
This task uses , , and as the expert wireless settings. Change these settings only when the network environment requires a different configuration.

step.cmd: Open a supported web browser on the connected device.

substep.cmd: Enter the current administrator password in the password field.

info.note: Change the default administrator password during the initial setup. Do not use the default administrator password during normal operation.

info.p: The location of the wireless settings can differ by software version.

step.cmd: Set the primary Wi-Fi network name to .

info.p: The Service Set Identifier (SSID) is the network name that appears on wireless devices.
info.note: Do not include personal information in the SSID.

info.p: Keep both supported Wi-Fi bands enabled. This setting provides compatibility for different client devices.
Use for compatible devices that require increased throughput. Use the 2.4 GHz band for devices that require more coverage or do not support 5 GHz.

step.cmd: Set the wireless security mode to .

info.p: Use the strongest security mode supported by the router and all client devices.
Use a long and unique password. Include a combination of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and permitted special characters.
info.note: Do not continue to use the default Wi-Fi password. Do not use the administrator password as the Wi-Fi password.

substep.cmd: Set the preferred frequency band to .

info.note: A fixed channel is not suitable for all environments. Use automatic channel selection if interference changes frequently.

info.p: Wait while the applies the new Wi-Fi settings.
info.note: The wireless connection can stop temporarily while the router applies the settings.

step.stepresult: The broadcasts the Wi-Fi network identified by .

step.cmd: Reconnect the configuration device to the Wi-Fi network.

substep.cmd: Open the Wi-Fi settings on the device.
Wait for the device to connect.

info.note: You do not need to complete this step if the configuration device uses a wired connection.

substep.cmd: Confirm that the device shows an active connection to .

step.stepresult: The device can access the home network and Internet services through Wi-Fi.

result.p: The Wi-Fi network uses the SSID , the security mode , and the password that you configured.

postreq.p: Connect the remaining client devices to by using the new .
